signals.observation: Rebecca Herzog is genuinely invisible in the public sphere. In an era of social media, candidate profiles, and local news coverage of every election, she managed to win an elected office without leaving a single searchable trace of her personal life, campaign, or views. She is, indeed, the Ghost of Ellis County.
